record.title: Hili zero-line truck blockades with an intervening opening, July 2018
record.region: South Asia, Central Asia and Caucasus
record.scope: Incoming cargo trucks from India into Bangladesh at Hili; no all-person or whole-frontier closure claimed.
record.movement: Incoming goods-laden trucks; stranded drivers and rice cargo provide context.
record.exceptions: Ten cargo trucks entered July3 before renewed blockade. Passenger restrictions not established.
record.imposing_authority: Indian cargo-truck drivers and helpers already inside Bangladesh
record.enforcement: Drivers physically occupied the zero-line approach and prevented cargo-truck entry.
record.relationship: One explicitly discontinuous blockade regime, with July2 and July3–5 phases recorded; no double-counted continuous spell.
record.official_rationale: Drivers demanded unloading of rice from trucks stranded inside Bangladesh.
record.context: Customs-duty/unloading dispute led drivers to obstruct incoming freight; the underlying unloading delay itself is not coded as a border closure.
record.uncertainty: Discontinuous regime: July2 blockade withdrawn; ten trucks entered July3 before renewed blockade. July5 actual entry is documented. No continuous July2–5 duration.

historical.duration_note: Pending root adjudication; no duration inferred from announcement or planned expiry.
